summary: Fix round 1, keryx server: AR2-001, DEG2-1, HL4-001, F-001 + RR-001 (server half), LG2-001, TP-005, TP2-001, SC3-001 (server half) fixed in src/** with tests. A terminal-results turn is now keryx's own turn (RunAgentTurnOptions.origin 'terminal-results'): its continuation line is stored as an injected harness line with a structural marker (NormalizedMessage.terminalContinuation, persisted), UserPromptSubmit does not fire for it, the floor is on, and replay keys on the marker. In-turn compaction keeps the latest Run-result head (notes + marked line) verbatim and the summary names removed Run results. The Run guidance bullet and terminalResults acceptance are gated on the new client capability initialize.clientCapabilities._meta.keryx.terminalResults (never on a Telegram turn; terminal: true alone gives neither). A note keeps the LAST 16 KiB of redacted output (capResultText keep: 'tail'). The shared private-key detector fails closed on an END line with no header. 10 new tests were red on the pre-fix sources; the test-gap findings (HL4-001, TP-005, parts of TP2-001) were green at head and each was shown sensitive by a mutation. One user-visible wording choice needs the operator: the leading cut marker.
summary_markdown:
## Behavior changes
1. (user_visible, needs_operator) A capped Run output now starts with `[… N earlier bytes not kept]` and keeps its last 16 KiB (was: first 16 KiB + trailing `[… truncated: N more bytes]`). The replayed run card shows this line. Alternatives: reuse the `truncated` wording; drop to the next newline after the cut.
2. (user_visible, settled by upheld SC3-001) `detectSecrets` masks from the previous block end (or the input start) to an `-----END … PRIVATE KEY-----` line that has no header before it, for every consumer (tool-output redaction, output validation, export audit), mirroring the existing header-without-END rule.
3. (not user-visible, settled by upheld AR2-001) A terminal-results turn no longer fires UserPromptSubmit; its line is `provenance: harness`, `injected`, `terminalContinuation`.
4. (model-facing, DEG2-1) Compaction summaries gain a `Run results removed from the active context (terminal-result notes):` section.

## For the orchestrator
- The desktop must advertise `initialize.clientCapabilities._meta.keryx.terminalResults: true` (T11). Until it does, every terminalResults prompt from that build is refused -32602 and its card says not sent.
- Spec §3.9.5b (T12) now differs from the code in four places, listed in metrics.doc_deltas.

acceptance.criterion: AC5: notes (provenance harness, nonce envelope, redactSensitiveText, capResultText), keryx's continuation line as the turn's user line, forged closing tag cannot end the envelope, malformed meta is invalid params with nothing stored and no turn.
acceptance.evidence: bun test src/acp/terminal-result: 68 pass, 0 fail. The line is stored as an injected harness line marked terminalContinuation (AR2-001); capResultText is used in its tail mode (LG2-001); the malformed list gains the resumeIssueQuestions combination (TP-005).

acceptance.criterion: AC6: the follow-up turn runs under the untrusted-content floor, except the floor's existing carve-outs.
acceptance.evidence: terminal-result.server.test.ts AC6 trust (with a plain-prompt control) and auto tests pass. The floor is now set by origin 'terminal-results' (agent.ts untrustedContentSeen) and still by untrustedPrompt. Carve-outs unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: AC7 (server half): session/load replays each note with _meta.keryx.terminalResult (never the envelope) and the continuation line with _meta.keryx.terminalContinuation; no turn starts.
acceptance.evidence: Stored-session and live end-to-end replay tests pass; they also pin the `$ <command>` fallback text, parentTurn [1,1,1,2] and [0,1], and that a typed note, a typed continuation sentence and an unmarked harness line replay as plain chunks. The desktop half is T11's.

acceptance.criterion: AC10: the Run sentence only for a client that advertised _meta.keryx.terminalResults: true and only on a non-Telegram turn; absent for terminal: true alone, other clients and Telegram turns; a terminalResults prompt without that capability is invalid params.
acceptance.evidence: Server tests: run-tracking client has the sentence; terminal-only, no-capability and editor-profile clients do not; a Telegram turn of a run-tracking desktop session does not while the desktop turn does; {} and terminal-only clients get -32602 with nothing stored or run. Unit: clientTakesTerminalResults, the bullet with/without clientReturnsRunResults.

acceptance.criterion: Every listed finding is fixed with a test that fails before the fix and passes after, or a note that it does not reproduce.
acceptance.evidence: Red on pre-fix sources: 10 tests (see metrics.findings). HL4-001 and TP-005 are test gaps that were correct at head (they do not reproduce as defects); TP2-001's text-fallback and injected-gate checks were correct at head too. Each was shown sensitive by a mutation of server.ts that turned its test red (8 mutations, all reverted; server.ts byte-identical to the fixed copy afterwards).
